surface-raised.$description: A band or panel set apart inside a surface: table headers, a side panel, a selected tab.

overlay.$description: Translucent scrim behind dialogs and sheets. Never under text that must be read.

default.$description: Body text, headings and values on every surface.

muted.$description: Secondary text: hints, captions, metadata, column headers. 4.5 : 1 on the app, surface and raised backgrounds and the subtle and default selection tints; not on selection.strong.

disabled.$description: Text and icons of a disabled control. 3 : 1, so it is still legible; disabled is also shown by the control's state, never by colour alone.

default.$description: Icon strokes next to text and in controls (Solar Broken, one tone): the text colour, near-black in light and light in dark (OD-65).

muted.$description: Icons that only decorate a value already written in words (a field's leading icon, a trigger's chevron). The same ink as color.icon.default since OD-65; kept as its own slot so a quieter icon can return with an owner decision.

default.$description: Card and divider lines. Decorative: never the only cue.

strong.$description: Borders that carry meaning alone (input outlines): 3 : 1 on every surface.

focus.$description: The 2 px focus outline of every interactive element; 3 : 1 on every surface. The focus halo (shadow.focus) sits outside it.

selection.$description: Tints of a selected item, mint from the brand green: rows, list items, calendar slots. Text stays color.text.default.

subtle.$description: A hovered row or a soft highlight.

default.$description: A selected row, list item or slot.

strong.$description: A selected item that is also hovered or pressed, and the range ends of a date range. Only color.text.default and color.icon.default sit on it.

bg.$description: The navigation rail and the top bar (deep green).

text.$description: Labels and icons on the navigation rail.

scan.$description: A code a camera reads (the TOTP QR code, slice A-01-07): the same light plate and dark modules in both themes, since many readers cannot read an inverted code.

bg.$description: The plate behind the modules: white in both themes.

fg.$description: The dark modules of the code: ink in both themes.

avatar.$description: Initials avatars of people (staff and patients), one hue per person picked from the name; no meaning, never red. Initials use the fg on the bg of the same hue.
